note: SYNTHETIC DATA for development and testing. Not Miami Dade College's catalog.

edge_cases.hidden_prerequisite: Some electives borrowed from other programs need prerequisites the program does not require (e.g. ZDA 3600 for Applied AI needs ZDA 3400). Each program's Electives group lists them under electives_with_outside_prerequisites.
edge_cases.cross_listed: ZAI 3200 (also listed as ZDA 3200) is required by both Applied AI and Data Analytics.
edge_cases.alternative_prerequisites: ZMA 2311 accepts ZMA 1105 or ZMA 1140; ZAI 3200 accepts either AI or Data Analytics prerequisites.
edge_cases.corequisite_lab: ZEE 2100 and ZEE 2100L must be taken together; lab sections carry linked_crn.
edge_cases.single_term_courses: Many electives and some core courses (e.g. ZEE 4200 Fall only, ZAI 4100 Spring only) run in one term.
edge_cases.credit_minimums: Capstones need 90 completed credits; internships need 60 and instructor permission.
edge_cases.inactive_course: ZEE 4570 is inactive and never scheduled.
edge_cases.unused_course: ZMA 1140 is not required by any program.
edge_cases.time_conflict_pair: In Spring 2027, the only sections of ZAI 3300 and ZAI 4200 overlap on TR.
edge_cases.all_sections_full: Every Fall 2026 section of ZSE 2400 is closed with a waitlist.
edge_cases.cancelled: One Spring 2027 ZHU 1020 section is cancelled.
